_README.note: Verified first-production or first-publication years, keyed by play title. This file is the ONLY source of `year_written` for scrape_contemporary_plays.py. A year here must come from a checked source about the PLAY itself: a publisher catalogue page, a premiere record, a Playbill/IBDB entry. It must NEVER be taken from a page label, an anthology or collection title, a 'Time Period' sidebar, or the word 'contemporary' appearing on the source page. That last mistake is what H-20 documents: 325 plays from 1892-1926 were labelled contemporary because the word appeared on a 1920 anthology cover. A title absent from this file gets year_written=NULL and is not categorised contemporary, however obviously modern it looks. Unknown is the safe answer; a guess is not.
